name: Odoo sync API errors
description: Počet API chýb v poslednom úplnom sync pokuse.

name: Odoo sync authentication errors
description: Počet chýb autentifikácie v poslednom úplnom sync pokuse.

name: Odoo sync permission errors
description: Počet permission chýb v poslednom úplnom sync pokuse.

name: Odoo sync rate-limit errors
description: Počet rate-limit chýb v poslednom úplnom sync pokuse.

name: Odoo sync retries
description: Počet retry pokusov v poslednom úplnom sync behu.

name: Odoo sync backlog
description: Počet záznamov čakajúcich na synchronizáciu po poslednom úplnom pokuse.

name: Oldest unsynced period age
description: Vek najstaršieho záznamu čakajúceho na synchronizáciu.

name: Event clock skew
description: Najväčší absolútny rozdiel medzi zdrojovým a ingest časom v úplnom event okne.
formula: max absolute source timestamp - ingest timestamp

name: Event processing lag p95
description: P95 času od prijatia eventu po ukončenie jeho spracovania v úplnom okne.
formula: p95 processing finished at - event received at

name: Dead-letter events
description: Počet eventov presunutých do dead-letter fronty v úplnom event okne.

name: Metric freshness
description: Podiel oprávnených metrík ktoré boli v čase kontroly čerstvé.

name: Metric completeness
description: Podiel oprávnených metrík s úplnými povinnými hodnotami a dimenziami.

name: Metric uniqueness
description: Podiel oprávnených metrík bez duplicitného business kľúča.

name: Metric validity
description: Podiel oprávnených metrík spĺňajúcich schému a rozsah hodnôt.

name: Metric consistency
description: Podiel oprávnených metrík konzistentných s deklarovanými vzťahmi a zdrojmi.

name: Data quality reconciliation difference
description: Absolútna odchýlka medzi porovnávanými zdrojmi v úplnom quality behu.

name: Data quality outliers
description: Počet oprávnených metrík označených schváleným detektorom ako outlier.

name: Unexpected zero values
description: Počet oprávnených metrík s neočakávanou nulovou hodnotou.

name: Unexpected volume spikes
description: Počet oprávnených metrík s neočakávaným nárastom objemu.

name: Numerator over denominator violations
description: Počet ratio metrík kde numerator prekročil denominator.
formula: count numerator greater than denominator violations

name: Invalid negative values
description: Počet metrík so zápornou hodnotou tam kde kontrakt povoľuje iba nezápornú.

name: Missing metric dimensions
description: Počet oprávnených metrík bez povinnej dimenzie.

name: Backup duration
description: Duration of the latest complete backup attempt.

name: Backup size
description: Stored bytes reported by the latest complete backup attempt.

name: Backup failures in 24 hours
description: Number of failed backup attempts in the previous 24 hours.

name: Retained backup snapshots
description: Current count of retained backup snapshots.

name: Point-in-time recovery enabled
description: Whether point-in-time recovery is enabled for the environment.

name: Point-in-time recovery window
description: Available point-in-time recovery window in seconds.

name: WAL archive health
description: Health of the applicable WAL or archive stream; omitted when PITR is not applicable.

name: Secondary backup copy health
description: Whether the independently stored secondary backup copy is healthy.

name: Backup encryption
description: Whether the latest complete backup evidence confirms encryption.

name: Monthly backup storage cost
description: Monthly backup storage cost attributed to the environment.

name: Restore duration
description: Duration of the latest complete restore test.

name: Restore checksum validation
description: Whether restored data passed checksum validation.

name: Missing records after restore
description: Count of records missing from the verified restore comparison.

name: Restored application smoke test
description: Whether the application smoke test passed against the restored system.

name: Restored tenant isolation
description: Whether tenant isolation passed in the restored system.

name: Next restore test overdue
description: Seconds by which the scheduled next restore test is overdue; zero until due.

name: Disaster recovery drill age
description: Time since the latest complete disaster recovery drill.

name: Disaster recovery drill success
description: Whether the latest complete disaster recovery drill succeeded.

name: DR failover duration
description: Measured failover duration in the latest complete DR drill.

name: DR failback duration
description: Measured failback duration in the latest complete DR drill.

name: DR DNS propagation duration
description: Measured DNS propagation duration during the latest complete DR drill.

name: Unavailable DR dependencies
description: Count of unavailable dependencies observed in the latest complete DR drill.

name: DR runbook accuracy
description: Percentage of executed DR runbook steps that were accurate.
formula: accurate runbook steps / executed runbook steps

name: Open DR remediation actions
description: Count of still-open remediation actions from the latest complete DR drill.

name: Next DR drill overdue
description: Seconds by which the scheduled next DR drill is overdue; zero until due.

name: Open pull requests
description: Count of pull requests open at the daily watermark.

name: PR cycle time p50
description: Median elapsed time from pull request opening to merge.

name: PR time to first review p50
description: Median elapsed time from pull request opening to first review.
formula: median first review at - opened at

name: PR approval to merge p50
description: Median elapsed time from approval to merge.

name: Average PR diff lines
description: Average changed lines per completed pull request.

name: Average PR files changed
description: Average changed files per completed pull request.

name: Average PR modules changed
description: Average changed modules per completed pull request.

name: Average PR comments
description: Average review comments per completed pull request.

name: Requested changes
description: Count of change-request review events in the closed day.

name: Stale pull requests
description: Count of open pull requests older than the approved stale threshold.

name: Reopened pull requests
description: Count of completed pull requests reopened during the closed day.

name: Average branch age
description: Average age of eligible active branches at the daily watermark.

name: Oldest branch age
description: Age of the oldest eligible active branch at the daily watermark.

name: Stale branches
description: Count of active branches older than the approved stale threshold.

name: Merge conflicts
description: Count of detected merge conflicts in eligible pull requests.

name: Direct main pushes
description: Count of direct pushes to protected production branches.

name: Branch protection bypasses
description: Count of branch protection bypass events.

name: Failed required checks
description: Count of failed required branch checks.

name: Emergency merges
description: Count of explicitly classified emergency merges.

name: Unreviewed production changes
description: Count of production changes merged without required human review.

name: Build count
description: Count of eligible CI builds completed in the closed day.

name: Build duration p95
description: 95th percentile duration of eligible completed CI builds.

name: Build queue time p95
description: 95th percentile time eligible builds waited before starting.

name: Flaky CI job rate
description: Percentage of eligible jobs that failed and passed without an applicable code change.

name: Unit test pass rate
description: Percentage of executed unit tests that passed.
formula: passed unit tests / executed unit tests

name: Integration test pass rate
description: Percentage of executed integration tests that passed.
formula: passed integration tests / executed integration tests

name: E2E test pass rate
description: Percentage of executed end-to-end tests that passed.
formula: passed end-to-end tests / executed end-to-end tests

name: Performance test pass rate
description: Percentage of executed performance tests that passed.
formula: passed performance tests / executed performance tests

name: Security test pass rate
description: Percentage of executed security tests that passed.
formula: passed security tests / executed security tests

name: Flaky test age
description: Average age of currently unresolved confirmed flaky tests.

name: Ignored tests
description: Count of tests explicitly disabled or ignored.

name: Skipped tests
description: Count of tests skipped in eligible executions.

name: Test duration p95
description: 95th percentile duration of eligible test jobs.

name: Critical path coverage
description: Coverage percentage for explicitly classified critical paths.
formula: covered critical items / eligible critical items

name: Mutation score
description: Percentage of eligible injected mutations killed by tests.

name: Bug reopen rate
description: Percentage of eligible resolved bugs reopened.

name: Active feature flags
description: Count of active feature flags at the daily watermark.

name: Feature flags without owner
description: Count of active feature flags without an accountable owner.

name: Feature flags without expiry
description: Count of active non-permanent feature flags without expiry.

name: Feature flag age p95
description: 95th percentile age of active feature flags.

name: Permanent feature flags
description: Count of active flags explicitly classified as permanent.

name: Flags untested on
description: Count of active feature flags without tested enabled behavior.

name: Flags untested off
description: Count of active feature flags without tested disabled behavior.

name: Feature flag rollbacks
description: Count of rollbacks performed through a feature flag.

name: Module boundary violations
description: Count of confirmed architecture module-boundary violations.

name: Cyclic dependencies
description: Count of confirmed dependency cycles.

name: Duplicate code rate
description: Percentage of eligible source lines classified as duplicated.
formula: duplicated source lines / eligible source lines

name: Complexity regression rate
description: Percentage of analyzed units whose complexity increased beyond policy.

name: Oversized files
description: Count of source files exceeding the approved size policy.

name: Oversized functions
description: Count of functions exceeding the approved size policy.

name: Dead code findings
description: Count of confirmed dead-code findings.

name: Unused dependencies
description: Count of confirmed unused declared dependencies.

name: TODO items
description: Count of policy-scoped TODO markers in source code.

name: Technical debt items
description: Count of open technical-debt items in the approved tracker.

name: Average technical debt age
description: Average age of open technical-debt items.
formula: average watermark - debt item created at

name: Sensitive code without CODEOWNER review
description: Count of sensitive production changes merged without required CODEOWNER review.
formula: count sensitive changes without CODEOWNER review
